question: According to the Planning Commission of India (2011-12), which group of states has the lowest percentage of population below the poverty line?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala and Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kerala and Himachal Pradesh have the lowest percentage of population below the poverty line according to the Planning Commission of India (2011-12).
 
• This outcome is indicative of the effective social welfare schemes and higher human development indices in these states.
 
• Both states have invested significantly in health, education, and social welfare, contributing to poverty reduction.
 
• The Planning Commission's data is crucial for understanding regional disparities in poverty across India.
